purpose: Chinese commercial promotions in channel and group text. Preserve normal sharing and official benefits. Not multilingual OCR or a guarantee of ad-free content.

publicSources.license: No explicit dataset license located; raw data not redistributed.

publicSources.usage: Only message_content ham/spam marked by admin_dashboard/group_admin; identifiers excluded
publicSources.license: No explicit dataset license located; raw data not redistributed.

publicSources.usage: 87 development probes relabeled for promotional intent, including preserving anti-fraud discussion. No raw text redistributed or directly trained.

training.checkpointSelection: Public validation precision >= .985 and FPR <= .005, then domain false positives, domain recall, public recall. Test labels never fitted.
training.grouping: Normalized deduplication, conflicting labels removed, near-duplicate TF-IDF char 3/4-grams grouped before split; not a channel-level split.

additionalRejectedStage.reason: Authored domain validation recall regressed; not selected for shipping

deviceAdaptation.policy: Normal software sharing, open source recommendations, official free credits and benefits retained; commercial promotion spans reviewed independently.

thresholdCalibration.method: Validation-only fine grid; same public precision/FPR constraints and domain priorities; test evaluated after selection

evaluation.warning: Public spam labels are noisy and differ from promotional intent. Scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities. Development regression results are not unseen generalization accuracy. End-to-end projection includes language/context/range safeguards.

nativeDevelopmentRegression.strictAdCoverage: Every non-whitespace character of an annotated ad span must be removed; partial contact-only removal counts as failure.

physicalDevice.scope: Production model/tokenizer/policy/projector in a local diagnostic app; separate from complete IPA installation.

privacy: No network or message upload in inference. Real-device messages and raw corpora are excluded from the repository. Classification outputs cannot generate original training messages.
limitations: Chinese only; unsupported languages preserved for explicit rules
No image, video or audio content recognition
Adversarial obfuscation, very short coded messages and advertorials can be missed
Normal content can be misclassified; originals remain stored and can be revealed
No self-training from predictions or automatic remote model updates

inference.wholeCardConsensus: Complete text and every meaningful blank-line block >= .99, at least two blocks >= span threshold, no substantive normal content or protected code. Only complete-card cuts use this floor.
inference.privacy: On-device, bounded background inference; no network requests.
